After that, I’d like to put a hold on one pair of black Sony XM5 headphones (product_id: p_sony_xm5_blk). Please look up my available coupons, including promo_code SAVE15, to determine the best discount for this purchase. Once you've found the best deal, go ahead and submit the order for the item in my items_list—specifically product_id p_sony_xm5_blk with a quantity of 1—using my credit_card as the payment_gateway. I also need you to analyze the text in my order_notes, which is "Standard shipping requested." Finally, please generate an invoice for this transaction and send it to my email at customer@example.com.
